goals: Verify the client-side application setup, including the MSAL CDN link in `index.html` and the integrity of the MSAL configuration object.
Ensure the server correctly serves the `index.html` page.
activities: Import the 'supertest' library for HTTP assertions.
Import the 'path' library for handling file paths.
Import the 'fs' library for file system operations.
Import the application server module.
Configure Jest to not mock the 'fs' module.
Read the content of 'index.html' file into a variable.
Set the global document's HTML content to the loaded 'index.html' string.
Get the 'src' attribute of the HTML element with ID 'load-msal'.
Verify that the 'src' attribute contains the expected CDN link 'https://alcdn.msauth.net/browser'.
Load the MSAL configuration object from 'authConfig.js'.
Verify that the 'msalConfig' object is defined.
Define a regular expression to match GUID format.
Test if the 'clientId' within 'msalConfig.auth' matches the GUID regular expression.
Verify that the 'clientId' does NOT match the GUID regular expression, ensuring it's not a credential.
Define a regular expression to match URI format.
Test if the 'authority' within 'msalConfig.auth' matches the URI regular expression.
Verify that the 'authority' matches the URI regular expression.
Set the Node.js environment variable 'NODE_ENV' to 'test'.
Send an HTTP GET request to the root path ('/') of the application.
Read the content of 'index.html' from the file system asynchronously.
Verify that the HTTP response status code is 200 (OK).
Verify that the HTTP response body text matches the content of the 'index.html' file.
